analysis_method: Extracted the hash-verified command from the selected Workbench disk in memory, parsed its HUNKs, and disassembled offline; the reference program was not executed.

entry_sequence: If the process has no CLI handle, Exec WaitPort/GetMsg obtains the Workbench startup message
After cleanup, Exec Forbid/ReplyMsg returns an acquired Workbench startup message

sequence: DOS Examine at code offset 0x00aa; continue only when the lock describes a directory
DOS ExNext at code offset 0x01cc until it returns zero
directory_scan.entry_policy: Each ExNext filename is tested for a case-insensitive .info suffix, which is removed in the FileInfoBlock filename buffer. No per-entry directory-type check precedes GetDiskObject; no recursive descent, wildcard matcher, NameFromLock, or AddPart call is present in this profile's code path.

driver_flow.operation: DOS UnLoadSeg when resident discovery or initialization fails

product_parser.numeric_rule: Each parsed field is validated as non-empty ASCII decimal digits before DOS StrToLong; signs, whitespace, and numeric-prefix tails are rejected.
product_parser.chain_rule: Returned ConfigDev nodes are linked through cd_NextCD at offset 48; the helper checks the accumulated chain before adding a returned node.

resident_search.match_rule: The candidate Resident rt_MatchTag pointer must point back to the candidate record.
resident_search.scope: The helper derives its scan end from the current segment's declared longword count and does not follow a next-segment link in the inspected implementation.

result_state.driver_entry_failures: Missing icon, PRODUCT, ConfigDev, resident, failed LoadSeg, and failed InitResident do not change the command result; an initialized segment is retained, while a failed initialization is unloaded.
result_state.diagnostics: No DOS PrintFault or output-formatting call is present in the statically disassembled command path.

evidence_limits: All call sites, string addresses, parser structure and result-state transitions are static HUNK observations; the reference program was not executed.
DOS provider effects, PRODUCT edge cases including overflow, IoErr publication, exact startup message behavior and Resident scanning boundaries require an original Workbench 3.1 guest comparison.
The selected media protection word has P clear; installed resident events and replacement package placement remain unresolved.
This audit neither authorizes source reuse nor qualifies a replacement for shipping.
